product_family: Data visualization platform for creating charts, maps, and tables without coding. Products: Free tier (core features), Custom tier ($599/month team plan), Enterprise tier (self-hosting, SSO, SLAs).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Datawrapper is fully certified according to the ISO 27001 norm, the world's best-known standard for information security management systems. Audited yearly against the ISO 27001 standard to make sure all safety procedures are appropriate and up to date.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or Type 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification. Not mentioned on security page, terms, or privacy policy.

certifications.name: GDPR (Compliance Posture, not a cert)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy updated to reflect the demands of GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), effective May 25, 2018. Named a person internally responsible for Data Protection.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement availability.

certifications.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy references contracted companies authorized to process personal data per GDPR, but no publicly available standard DPA template. Contact support@datawrapper.de for formal DPA.

privacy.ai_training_note: No public evidence of using customer data for AI model training. Platform integrates with AI tools (MCP) but does not train models on user visualizations or data.
privacy.data_region: European Economic Area (EEA) - Data centers in Stockholm and Frankfurt; AWS infrastructure.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS (Transport Layer Security) implemented across all systems

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Data encrypted at rest; customer and system data backed up daily

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: Western European data centers (Stockholm and Frankfurt); user data remains in EEA; AWS infrastructure

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Third-party penetration tests performed at least once annually

security.name: Code Review
security.value: All code undergoes peer review; security testing in staging environments before release

security.name: Disaster Recovery
security.value: Infrastructure distributed across two AWS datacenters; daily backups with matching encryption standards

security.name: Access Controls (Enterprise)
security.value: SAML2 and OpenID-based Single Sign-On available for enterprise customers

security.name: Data Privacy
security.value: Does not sell customer data to third parties; visualizations are tracking-free and CCPA-compliant

products.name: Free Plan
products.data_scope: Unlimited free visualizations (charts, maps, tables); PNG export; Datawrapper attribution
products.notes: No cost; core features for individuals and small projects

products.name: Custom Plan (Team)
products.data_scope: $599/month or $5,990/year; 10 user licenses; SVG/PNG/PDF export; full customization; no attribution
products.notes: 20% discount for non-profit organizations; additional users at $21/month each

products.name: Enterprise Plan
products.data_scope: Custom pricing; self-hosting option; SAML2/OpenID SSO; SLAs; on-demand support
products.notes: For large organizations requiring advanced security and control; data can be self-hosted in customer's own S3/GCS/SFTP

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered subscriptions (Free, Custom, Enterprise)
compare.data_residency: EEA (Western Europe: Stockholm, Frankfurt); self-hosting available on Enterprise tier
